cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: We Needed the Break
cards.instruction: Frame a rupture, absence, or failed connection as a healthy decision that ultimately helped.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've left Sunday blank like your calendar. That year apart taught us not to crowd each other. Coffee Sunday?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: My calendar hasn't synced. I've booked pottery, and you used to insist every Sunday was ours.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Yes, keeping our own calendars. We needed the break. I'll ask you about Monday instead.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Monday's free. But I'm not giving up pottery every week.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Keep pottery. Before that year apart I'd have asked you to cancel it. Monday's enough for me.

reason: Replace generic lesson summary with a specific contrast and reassurance responding to B protected weekly activity.
